title: WR Jalen Coker agrees to three-year extension with Panthers

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: WR Jalen Coker agrees to three-year extension with Panthers
sources.description: The Panthers and wide receiver Jalen Coker agreed to terms on a three-year, $35 million extension, Ian Rapoport of NFL Media reports.
